summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of alec.studio site. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (root, create inquiry full, minimal, invalid email 422, missing required 422, GET sort desc, persistence via create->GET). Frontend: All 6 nav routes work with correct data-testids, Home hero CTAs, both featured 'View Live Site' links, Work page real projects + exactly 4 'concept-label' items, Services page 6 numbered cards visible + services-lets-talk, all 5 process-step-01..05, about-portrait, empty-submit form validation (form remained, no POST), full contact form submission with need/budget shadcn selects succeeded and contact-success panel displayed. Verified backend persistence of UI-created inquiry via GET /api/inquiries.
action_items: Optional: add data-testid="service-card-01..06" on Services page cards for stronger test coverage (currently only inferred via headings and grid children).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Inquiry endpoint response uses response_model=Inquiry which is fine; GET properly excludes _id. Good.
CORS uses env with '*' fallback; acceptable for MVP.
Contact.jsx client-side validation checks name/email/message; server also enforces via Pydantic. Consistent.
Lenis console warning about container position is a minor UX/dev warning, not a functional bug.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed inquiries via pytest and one TESTUI_ inquiry via UI submission. Not cleaned up (only add-only endpoints exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows verified end-to-end. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be rerun as regression. UI shadcn Select needs a ~400ms wait after opening before clicking option; already handled in playwright script.
